summary: fractal-ui's composer gains a send surface: recipient readout and selection, a reply chip and optional subject, an image tray, availability recovery, and Sending/Sent captions on transcript rows

schema.detail: No tables, columns, indexes or triggers.

rules.detail: Checkpoint rules and digests are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: Only packages/fractal-ui changes; no protocol, harness or CLI change. EmbraceComposer gains optional props (recipient, recipients, onRecipientChange, reply, onClearReply, subject, onSubjectChange, images, imagePolicy, onRemoveImage, onRetryImage, availability); hosts that omit them see the composer as before, except the toolbar's attach button now appears only when the runtime has an attachments adapter. The send state's Failed variant gains optional code and retryable, and Transcript and EmbraceThread gain an optional sendAvailability. User prompts now caption Pending as Sending… and Sent as Sent.
